line: A letter, a phone call, a wall of windows, thirteen steps: the girl who told him not to look back is always one step closer, until she turns her head.
line_cn: 一封信、一通电话、一面窗墙、十三级台阶：叫他别回头的她每一话都更近一步，直到她自己猛地回头。

camera.move: Fast push into a one-point corridor, stairs or street, perfectly symmetric
camera.serves: a summons; a chase; a countdown

camera.move: Extreme offset: subject at one edge, half the frame empty
Hard push into one element of a grid (a locker, a window)
camera.serves: a choice; a clue; a name on a list

camera.move: Lateral track along an orthogonal wall
camera.serves: a corridor; a facade; an archive

camera.move: Beat-locked step push (the camera jumps one step per beat)
Low angle from below a figure at the top of a space
camera.expresses: power, the end of a path

camera.move: Insert at 1:1 scale (an eye, a hand, a letter) held under a slow push
camera.serves: a reveal; a touch; a message

camera.move: Multi-panel grid of one face cropped many ways
camera.serves: a stalker; a crowd of selves; memory

camera.move: Split frame: picture on one side, a speaker's rail on the other
camera.serves: a phone call; an interrogation; a confession

transitions: Transitions are cuts, 1–6 frames of inversion, a one-point tunnel rush, or a red slit opening on black.
Never dissolves, wipes or page turns, and never a fully black frame between shots (use the slit).
labels: Cards and titles: Noto Serif SC 900 (heavy Mincho feel, OFL). Single glyphs 700–1100 px, allowed to bleed off the frame on flash cards; dialogue columns 120–170 px, never bleeding.
Small vertical notes (episode numbers, speaker tags, counters): Noto Sans SC 900, 40–64 px.
English: one line of Cormorant Garamond Italic 600, about a quarter of the Chinese size, grey on black or white, black on red.
Vertical punctuation: 。and ，move to the top right of their cell; ？stays upright.
motion: Editing is the animation: flash cards 2–9 frames at 30 fps; architecture shots 0.3–1.6 s; nothing static for more than a second. Lock cuts to a beat grid (150 BPM = 12 frames a beat works well at 30 fps; 8th = 6 frames, 16th = 3 frames).
Card slam: frame 0 at 1.08×, frame 1 at 1.02×, then 1.0; jitter 10–14 px on the first two frames, 1–3 px after (whole-pixel random per frame, no motion blur).
Rails slam in from the frame edge in 3 frames and are counted as on screen only when complete.
Characters move by layers and steps, not tweens: a head layer rotated about the neck, a figure that jumps closer once per beat, a silhouette that bobs once per step.

native_moves.name: Flash card
native_moves.does: (shotCard): a solid field, one giant glyph (bleed allowed), slam + jitter, 2–9 frames; cards alternate with 3–6-frame picture cuts in a "type–image–type" saw-tooth.
native_moves.fits: a countdown; a list of demands; a word that interrupts.

native_moves.name: Speaker rail
native_moves.does: (rail): a full-height column at the left or right edge in the speaker's colour, vertical type plus one English line and a one-glyph speaker tag; the picture beside it keeps cutting while the line holds.
native_moves.fits: a phone call; a confession; a two-hander argument.

native_moves.name: Chapter card
native_moves.does: (shotChapter): one enormous glyph, a vertical episode number, an English line, a colour bar cutting in; four layouts so no two chapters look alike.
native_moves.fits: a series trailer; a manifesto in parts; a product in four promises.

native_moves.name: The head tilt
native_moves.does: (shotTurn): the character art split into head and body layers (head polygon + neck pivot + a black collar patch that hides the seam). Back-turned (head −35°) → 60 ms wind-up → 120 ms whip to +0.1 rad with overshoot → 0.1·e^(−9t)·cos(26t) settle. The whip happens in full silhouette with three ghost heads; the frame it settles cuts hard to colour with 2 frames of red-black inversion.
native_moves.fits: a reveal; a challenge; a brand mascot's "look".

native_moves.name: Symbolic architecture
native_moves.does: geometric stairs (treads scaled by r^k, red light climbing the risers), window tunnel (nested rectangles k = 1/(z·0.32+0.08)), one-point street with lamps scaled by depth, locker wall, window wall.
native_moves.fits: a school; an office tower; a city at night.

native_moves.name: Stepping approach
native_moves.does: a figure that is redrawn larger once per beat, never tweened.
native_moves.fits: a deadline; a rival; an incoming storm.

native_moves.name: Fragment insert
native_moves.does: eye, hand, mouth corner or object at frame-filling scale for 6–24 frames, slammed and jittered. A reflection drawn into the iris ties two characters together.
native_moves.fits: a clue; a touch; a lie.

native_moves.name: Multi-panel faces
native_moves.does: one portrait cropped nine ways in a 3×3 grid (full, eye, mouth, upside down, silhouette), appearing on 16ths, then all heads tilt together with staggered springs.
native_moves.fits: surveillance; a split personality; many fans.

native_moves.name: Count-up acceleration
native_moves.does: numerals as flash cards alternating with ever-shorter architecture shots.
native_moves.fits: a launch; floors of a building; days until.

native_moves.name: Object on a solid field
native_moves.does: a key, a cracked watch, a ticket, drawn flat in red, black and white.
native_moves.fits: a product; a clue; a keepsake.

score.note: harpsichord ostinato in 16ths, pizzicato low strings, woodblock clock, lullaby glockenspiel
